entities.name: Query protein TusC
observations: The 119-residue sequence has an exact sequence match to reviewed UniProt protein Q89A63 from Buchnera aphidicola.
Predicted molecular weight is 13,616.946 Da; theoretical pI is 9.04; estimated charge at pH 7 is +2.58.
Pfam analysis identifies a DsrE domain (PF02635.21) spanning residues 2–119.
Homology-based annotations place the protein in the cytoplasm.

entities.name: TusC
observations: TusC is a component of the sulfur-relay system required for 2-thiolation of 5-methylaminomethyl-2-thiouridine (mnm5s2U) at tRNA wobble positions.
Curated homologs include Q89A63, B8D9V4, and P57597 from Buchnera aphidicola.
The exact-match reference Q89A63 is reviewed and annotated as cytoplasmic.
